## IMPORTANT

If your concern involves an imminent safety risk, do not use GitHub Issues. Contact the project directly at Admin@clubout.club.

If your concern involves a legal matter, sensitive personal data, or information that should not be publicly visible, describe only what is necessary to identify the concern here — do not reproduce the sensitive content.

---

<!-- What harm could this content cause? Who or what is at risk? -->

## What change would address the concern?

- [ ] Removal or suppression of specific content
- [ ] Aggregation or generalization (e.g. replace precise coordinates with a regional boundary)
- [ ] Addition of a safety caveat or limitation note
- [ ] Referral to a named-actor right-of-reply process
- [ ] Other: ___

## Additional context

<!-- Any other information that helps us assess the concern. -->

---

Exposure concerns are reviewed by the safeguards panel. We aim to acknowledge all concerns within five business days and provide a substantive response within ten. The outcome (removed, modified, retained with added caveats, or retained with explanation) will be noted in the public corrections record where it is safe to do so.
